column1: # (predefinedEnhancementInfo.kt, Kotlin 2.4.21): the nullability kotlinc's Java signature enhancement
# gives each position of a JDK method that carries no nullability annotations of its own. Only the
# entries of the JDK methods a read-only collection face realizes as stubs (mutable_jdk_methods_2_4.tsv)
# are ported; `List.sort` and `Map.remove(Object, Object)` have no entry, so every position of theirs
# stays flexible. The `addFirst`/`removeFirst` family reports errors since language version 2.1, so
# its enhancement applies to Kotlin 2.4 unconditionally.
# This is checked-in policy data; it is not generated during the build.
# Each position lists one qualifier per component of its declared type, in kotlinc's pre-order
# (the type itself, then each type argument): `nullable` (T?), `not-platform` (T), `not-null`
# (T & Any), or `-` (flexible). A position without qualifiers is a single `-`.
